enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Rinse hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into bowl. Add milk. Stir with fork. Pour mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out butter. Close refrigerator. Spread butter on toast. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put dishes away.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the room and setting up the desk lamp and computer for the work-from-home day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Pick up clothes from floor. Place clothes in hamper. Make bed. Flatten sheets. Arrange pillows. Pick up items from desk. Organize papers. Plug in computer. Turn on desk lamp. Adjust lamp angle. Open computer. Sit on chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking email, reviewing the day's program schedule, and planning tasks on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email application. Click on inbox. Read emails. Reply to emails. Type response. Send email. Open calendar. Review schedule. Open task manager. Create task list. Type task items. Prioritize tasks. Save task list. Close email. Open program schedule document. Read schedule. Make notes. Highlight important items. Save document.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: coordinating community programs, drafting reports, and joining video meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Open program coordination software. Review program details. Send messages to team members. Type message. Send message. Open report template. Type report content. Format document. Save report. Open video meeting link. Join meeting. Turn on camera. Adjust microphone. Speak during meeting. Listen to others. Take notes. Share screen. End meeting. Close video application. Continue drafting report. Edit report. Save report.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch container. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place container inside. Close microwave. Set timer. Press start. Wait for microwave. Open microwave. Take out container. Close microwave. Place container on counter. Open container lid. Pick up fork. Eat lunch. Drink water. Close container. Wash fork. Dry fork. Put fork away.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighborhood for fresh air
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Walk down sidewalk. Turn left at corner. Continue walking. Cross street. Walk past park. Turn around. Walk back. Cross street again. Walk up sidewalk. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Working from home: following up with partner organizations, updating program documents, and answering calls
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Read new emails. Reply to partner organization. Type email. Send email. Open program document. Update contact list. Add new information. Save document. Answer phone call. Speak on phone. Take notes. End call. Open spreadsheet. Update budget. Save spreadsheet. Send follow-up email. Close email. Open calendar. Schedule meeting. Send meeting invite.

enriched_activities.activity: Wrapping up work tasks and logging off for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Save all open documents. Close report file. Close spreadsheet. Close email application. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Stretch arms. Push chair under desk. Pick up phone. Check messages. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up items from floor. Place items on shelf. Move chairs. Plug in vacuum cleaner. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move furniture to vacuum underneath. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wind cord. Put vacuum away. Fluff pillows. Arrange cushions.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, then loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board and knife. Chop vegetables. Cut chicken. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Stir. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Eat dinner. Drink water. Open dishwasher. Place plate in dishwasher. Place glass in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel again. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV.

Walk out of house. Walk down driveway. Turn right on sidewalk. Walk along street. Pass houses. Cross street. Walk around block. Turn left. Continue walking. Observe surroundings. Turn around. Walk back. Cross street. Return to house. Walk up driveway. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and browsing on the phone with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Open book to page. Sit on bed. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open browser. Scroll through feed. Click on article. Read article. Close browser. Open social media. Scroll. Like post. Comment. Close social media. Lock phone. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Lather body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply to hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off bathroom light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and charging the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Plug in charger. Connect charger to phone. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off desk lamp. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Sleep.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Turn to other side. Sleep.
